jobs.prompt: Stylized 3D game building, isometric three-quarter view from the front-right with the main entrance facing the viewer, a single building isolated on a pure black background. KULT SYNDICATES HEADQUARTERS: a converted rail depot turned underground syndicate headquarters. A wide brick-and-dark-steel warehouse with a sawtooth roof and glowing skylights, a huge glowing hot-orange freight door as the main entrance, a rooftop water tower wearing a glowing neon crest of an interlocked chain link, stacked shipping containers on the right side, a short rail track crossing the front with a small parked locomotive, catwalks, a signal mast with a red lamp, warm string lights. No text, no letters, no logos, no people, no large ground plane.
